metadata.description: Downloaded unity3d files from every version of the My Singing Monsters Official Guide app, including some from beta versions of the app and an unreleased update from 2019. This app is notable for having high quality versions of the Dawn of Fire sprites as well as the My Singing Monsters sprites prior to the release of the Steam port. The latest version of the unreleased update is 1428 uploaded to the DLC servers on October 23, 2019.
